critical_code_review_comments: routes/csv_io.py import path uses `from routes.customers import _validate_customer` and `from routes.properties import enforce_scheme` — importing '_-prefixed' private helpers across modules is a mild layering smell. Consider exposing a public validator in each module (or moving the validators to a shared `validators.py`) so the router file isn't the source of truth for cross-module contracts.
routes/customers.py update_customer: `payload.pop('id', None); payload.pop('_id', None)` — the try/except wrapping _validate_customer just re-raises; the try/except is a no-op and can be removed.

routes/csv_io.py _import_properties builds `Property(**{...})` but filters values with `if v is not None or k in ('images','features')` which will drop legitimate 0 / False / empty-string fields — for the current schema this is fine because none of those fields are meaningful at zero/False, but worth documenting.

CsvToolbar.jsx: the file input is not cleared between imports (fileRef.current.value never reset); a second import of the same filename would still work because we read from files[0], but the input visually still shows the previous filename after the modal reopens.

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral only — TEST_ITER27_* customers and TEST_ITER27_* properties, all deleted in session teardown fixture. Backend restart to verify Phase 3 did not mutate any existing docs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-27 CSV endpoints live at /api/admin/{properties|customers}/{,csv,csv/template,csv/schema} — schema is the single source of truth for the Import Guide table + required headers hint in the modal. Property schema has 30 fields (12 required = 6 mandatory + 6 conditional), Customer schema has 10 fields (4 required, all mandatory). Import is APPEND-ONLY: rows with an existing `id` are added to `skipped`, never overwritten. Row-level validation reuses `enforce_scheme` (properties) and `_validate_customer` (customers) so the CSV path is guaranteed to match the interactive UI behaviour. Leads have NOT been touched this iteration by design — LeadCreate still has Optional email/phone; do not re-file that as a bug.
